name: cytoscape
notes: General-purpose graph renderer and analysis library. Zero runtime dependencies, SLSA provenance, canvas renderer, layouts via extensions (dagre, cose-bilkent, fcose). 138 KB gzip.

build_vs_buy.effort: 6-12 months for a comparable renderer and layout suite
build_vs_buy.rationale: Graph rendering and layout are a buy; zero dependencies make this buy easy.
